scope: Original-PNG Image and NineSlice primitives, independent of inventory ItemImage semantics. No generated artwork, bundled generic skin, asset fetcher, atlas engine or runtime dependency is added.

basis.interpretation: Minecraft image controls name a texture and logical control size; companion texture JSON can give base_size and nineslice_size. The library keeps these meanings explicit rather than inferring that one PNG texel always equals one game pixel.

fullReleaseReference.note: The pinned git UI file is reachable, but its raw bytes differ from this release. The cited image definitions are independently checked in installed JSON and the full-release JSONC.

httpVerification.method: Actual HTTP GET via urllib; all cited raw references returned 200; PNG response hashes match the fixture input bytes.

required: sourceSize: readonly [physical PNG width, physical PNG height]

optional.size: readonly [logical GUI width, logical GUI height], defaults to sourceSize
optional.draggable: native img attribute, defaults to false
optional.style: native CSSProperties; consumer overrides default display width/height

Image.geometry: Native width/height attributes and CSS width/height are size * scale, emitted during server rendering. No browser measurement or load-triggered layout change. sourceSize is caller-declared actual PNG dimensions; mismatched files cannot be detected without loading and are outside this pure component contract.
Image.semantics: alt is required. Use alt="" for decoration; informative and functional images keep native img naming. Native onLoad/onError, loading, decoding, className, data attributes and ARIA props are forwarded.

NineSlice.element: div with one non-interactive span image layer, followed by original children
required: sourceSize: readonly [physical PNG width, physical PNG height]

optional.destinationBorder: logical GUI-pixel number or named insets; defaults numerically to slice
optional.size: OUTER logical dimensions, including destination edges; omitted means normal child-driven layout
optional.fill: boolean, defaults to true; false leaves the center transparent
optional.alt: names only the separate image layer; omitted or empty means decorative
optional.children: ordinary content; remains accessible and interactive
optional.style: consumer overrides default outer width/height/minimums/padding, independently of the image layer

NineSlice.geometry: source slice maps to CSS border-image-slice in top/right/bottom/left order; destination border = destinationBorder * scale CSS pixels. The image layer occupies the complete outer box with border-image-outset:0 and stretch edge repetition. Root padding reserves exactly the destination edges by default, so children occupy the remaining inner box. CSS border-box means explicit size already includes these edges; padding does not extend the requested outer dimensions.
NineSlice.automaticSize: Without size, normal CSS content layout plus destination padding determines outer dimensions. With no children, minimum width/height is the sum of horizontal/vertical destination edges.
NineSlice.semantics: The frame is decorative by default. A nonempty alt adds role=img and aria-label to the image span only; the outer div does not become role=img, so descendant controls retain their own semantics. The image layer has pointer-events:none and cannot intercept children.
NineSlice.styleOverrideLimit: Defaults can be intentionally overridden by consumer style. Pixel evidence covers unmodified geometry at an integer device-pixel origin; transforms, fractional parent layout, CSS overrides and a different device pixel ratio require their own verification.

sharedTypes.ImageInsets: { readonly left: number; readonly top: number; readonly right: number; readonly bottom: number }

api.runtime: forwardRef only; no useEffect, window/document access, natural-size fetching, canvas or hydration dependency. Both primitives render using react-dom/server.

validationPolicy.slice: Nonnegative safe integer physical pixels. Left+right must not exceed physical width; top+bottom must not exceed physical height. Equal sums are allowed as a zero-size center; no pixels are invented for that center.
validationPolicy.destinationBorder: Nonnegative finite logical values; multiplication by scale and edge sums must stay finite.
validationPolicy.size: Positive finite logical values; multiplied outer dimensions must be finite and must contain the destination borders. Fractional logical values are allowed, but are not automatically pixel-certified.
validationPolicy.failure: Invalid numeric parameters throw RangeError during both client and static server render. No silent clamping, negative CSS dimensions or NaN serialization. Consumer-supplied style is standard CSS and remains the consumer responsibility.

sourceExamples.explanation: The texture has 2 physical texels per logical base pixel. Metadata nineslice_size=1 becomes a physical source cut of 2; at GUI2 its destination edge is still 2 CSS pixels, not 4.

sourceExamples.ordering: The source metadata array uses left/top/right/bottom. The public API uses named fields; CSS receives top/right/bottom/left.

verification.pixelComparison: Full original PNG sampling, independent source hashes, no screenshot-derived baseline and no allowed differing pixels. Cases cover direct integer magnification, physical/logical density, scalar/asymmetric cuts, retained edge density and transparent center.
additionalChecks: Node static server render without browser globals
Native image names, decorative alt and unchanged fixture source bytes
Forwarded img/div refs and consumer attributes
Explicit outer geometry, reserved content padding and Enter activation of child button
Consumer style can intentionally override outer dimensions and padding
verification.fixtureAlignment: Specimen is laid out at viewport (0,0), without a fractional transform. Native heading em margins and fractional compositor translations otherwise add edge filtering unrelated to source cut arithmetic.
verification.acceptanceLimit: These checks prove web rendering against original PNG raster/metadata for these cases. They do not compare a complete native Bedrock frame or prove native final renderer snapping.

rights.fixturePngs: Unchanged official Mojang sample PNG bytes embedded as data URLs for reproducible offline fixture rendering; preserve upstream attribution and license.
rights.library: No artwork or asset is generated or silently fetched by Image/NineSlice. Caller supplies src.
